newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian tin, nickel prices ease in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian tin, nickel prices ease in light trade.

text.p: Tin and nickel prices eased in dull, light trade on Friday but lead prices rose, dealers said.
They said attendance was poor due to disruption of traffic after a partial strike by trade unions against the killing of a labour leader on Thursday.
Tin and nickel each shed 200 rupees, to 34,400 and 36,700 per quintal respectively. Lead rose 50 rupees to 4,500 on shortage of ready stock and limited inflow.
Copper was steady at 12,600 rupees per quintal, aluminium at 7,200 rupees and zinc at 6,650 rupees in light trade.
